question: Among ISSUED entities incorporated in Luxembourg, which three legal forms are most common, excluding the placeholder codes 8888 and 9999? Give the legal form name and the count.

attempts.sparql:
PREFIX gleif-L1: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/L1/>
PREFIX gleif-base: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/Base/>
PREFIX jur: <https://www.gleif.org/data/jurisdiction/>
PREFIX elf: <https://www.gleif.org/data/elf/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?formName (COUNT(?e) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?e a gleif-L1:RegisteredEntity ;
     gleif-base:hasRegistrationStatus gleif-L1:ISSUED ;
     gleif-base:hasLegalJurisdiction jur:LU ;
     gleif-L1:hasLegalForm ?form .
  FILTER(?form NOT IN (elf:8888, elf:9999))
  ?form rdfs:label ?formName .
}
GROUP BY ?form ?formName
ORDER BY DESC(?count)
LIMIT 3

sparql:
PREFIX gleif-L1: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/L1/>
PREFIX gleif-base: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/Base/>
PREFIX jur: <https://www.gleif.org/data/jurisdiction/>
PREFIX elf: <https://www.gleif.org/data/elf/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?formName (COUNT(?e) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?e a gleif-L1:RegisteredEntity ;
     gleif-base:hasRegistrationStatus gleif-L1:ISSUED ;
     gleif-base:hasLegalJurisdiction jur:LU ;
     gleif-L1:hasLegalForm ?form .
  FILTER(?form NOT IN (elf:8888, elf:9999))
  ?form rdfs:label ?formName .
}
GROUP BY ?form ?formName
ORDER BY DESC(?count)
LIMIT 3

question: Which three fund managers manage the most funds? Give the manager's legal name and the count.

attempts.sparql:
PREFIX gleif-L1: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/L1/>
PREFIX kgx: <https://example.org/gleif-kg/ontology/>

SELECT ?managerName (COUNT(DISTINCT ?fund) AS ?fundCount)
WHERE {
  ?fund kgx:hasFundManager ?manager .
  ?manager gleif-L1:hasLegalName ?managerName .
}
GROUP BY ?manager ?managerName
ORDER BY DESC(?fundCount) ?managerName
LIMIT 3
